# Third-party sources

- [DDA](https://github.com/roy-ch/Dual-Data-Alignment): LoRA layers, Apache-2.0.
- [DINOv2](https://github.com/facebookresearch/dinov2): vision transformer and supporting layers, Apache-2.0.

Modified DINOv2 imports to use this package and omitted the unused training-head export.
License texts are retained in each source directory.
